Commuting to work in the light of the NSP 2021

dedupe_keys.name: gus national census 2021 matrix of employment related commuting flows between gminas poland

description: Statistics Poland published the matrix of employment-related population flows from the 2021 National Population and Housing Census as one workbook. Its main sheet lists each pair of gmina of residence and gmina of work, by seven-digit territorial code and name, with the number of commuters, in about 95,890 rows; two further sheets total the outgoing and incoming commuters of each gmina. Urban-rural gminas are split into their town and rural parts, as in the Bolesławiec rows. Headings are in Polish and English. A companion report on commuting to work is listed with the final results. Format and access: XLSX, free to download, no registration. Licence: the GUS copyright note allows copying and adapting data on condition that the source is given; free. Caveats: flows of fewer than 3 people are left out, so the matrix undercounts small flows; there is no mode of transport or distance, and there are no geometries, so gmina boundaries must be joined from another source. Simulation uses: origin and destination demand for regional transport models, commuter exposure and accessibility studies, and agent-based travel demand. Related records: the GUS housing conditions tables, the GUS transport statistics and the Danish and Czech census commuting matrices.
